A joint initiative by Two organisations. One mission for Bengal's farmers.

The big idea

A league built around better farms, not a stadium.

Like a sporting league, KRL brings teams, a season and recognition. But here, every participant’s farm is the playing field. Progress is measured by how thoughtfully that farm grows through productivity, integrated practice, management and market readiness.

“We are searching for the ratnas, the jewels among our farmers.”

Mahacharya Sourabh J. Sarkar, interview summary

The journey

From one plot to a state-wide movement

The interview describes a simple path: express interest, earn selection, transform a farm and contribute to a team’s shared score.

  1. 01

    Register interest

    Agricultural youth and farming enthusiasts apply through the organisers’ official channel.

  2. 02

    Selection

    The model proposes roughly 20 selected participants from each of Bengal’s 294 constituencies.

  3. 03

    Build the farm

    Participants spend one year improving their own land with training, technology and management support.

  4. 04

    Compete together

    Individual progress and the combined performance of each zonal team lead to recognition and prizes.

What participants gain

Support for the whole farming journey

The initiative is designed to pair individual responsibility with practical support, from field decisions to selling beyond the local market.

01

Modern farm training

Guidance for smart, integrated and technology-enabled agriculture.

02

Management support

Help to plan, operate and steadily improve a farm over the league year.

03

Market connections

Facilitation for sales, export readiness and connections beyond Bengal.

Announced financial framework

A seed for transformation

The interview outlines the following proposed grants and prizes. Final amounts, eligibility and disbursement terms should be confirmed in the official rules before anyone applies or contributes.

Selected participant grant₹1 lakh

Proposed for each of approximately 5,000 selected farmers to help develop their farm over one year.

Individual champion₹1 crore

Announced prize for the highest-performing individual farmer.

Winning team₹1 crore

Announced team prize based on the zone’s combined farm scores.

Additional categories₹1 crore

Announced combined fund for other categories and recognitions.

Global Bengali connection

From ancestral soil to a farmer’s next chapter

KRL proposes a distinctive sponsorship model: prosperous Bengalis living around the world support selected agricultural youth connected to their ancestral constituency. The contribution is framed not as charity, but as a bridge back to bhite mati, the soil of one’s roots.

See sponsorship readiness →
60days

The demonstration benchmark

Can a neglected site become a model smart farm?

The interview describes a planned 60-day transformation of an urban waste-dump site into an ideal integrated farm during Durga Puja. Before publication as a formal case study, the location, dates, methods and measured results should be documented.

Before applications open

Official participation details are still required

The source interview explains the vision, but does not provide dates, a live registration URL, formal eligibility, scoring rules or financial terms. This site will direct visitors only after those details are officially published.
